completed_stage: Single-A8 operator implementation, implementation-correctness tests, two unprofiled screens and separate hardware counters.
single_request_result: Do not enable: negligible gain; MLP-down consistently regresses about 4%.
multi_request_result: T4/T8/T23/T32 pass the predefined operator speed screen; T1/T2 do not. T8 quantization+projection latency reductions approximately 16.5%-25%. Not full-model TPS.
quality: Synthetic operator relative-L2 error approximately 0.51%-0.58% for Gaussian inputs; up to 0.814% for group-outlier inputs. Constructed small-feature loss retained as a counterexample. No corpus or complete-model quality gate.
numerical_reference: Same production Q8 weight bytes; reference leaves activations in F16, computes projection in F32, sampled independent F64 validation. Not original BF16 checkpoint/model reference.
next_gate: Use actual native model activations, teacher logits, trajectories and corpus metrics before considering a model-level lower-precision mode. Full model would need memory currently held by production.
local_code: Only parameterized existing row-pair and column kernels with a default two-pass template parameter; one-pass C ABI lives in the standalone research TU and is not included by the native build.
production_health: Same container/config/start time, healthy before and after. Mac API health check returned status ok.
analysis_repair: Offline audit normalizes the GPU- prefix in NVML UUIDs; raw measurements were unchanged.
